title: Runtime-Bound Accepted Receipt Owner Association Remediation
qualified_evidence: Runtime-owned accepted receipt is bound at the physical commit callsite; there is no public after-the-fact binder for an already-existing generic receipt.
Serialized runtime derives the receipt owner from the validated executing logical column_id, not from a reusable worker slot or hidden global counter.
Own prepared handle plus a real same-scalar-tuple foreign-column owned receipt fails closed and leaves the rightful prepared state intact.
The rightful owner receipt subsequently commits exactly once.
Generic accepted-receipt export compatibility is preserved for callers that need the column-agnostic F-MR receipt.
Existing bottom-energy accepted-only publication semantics replay PASS at O0 and O2.
F-KT18 mass completeness and rejected committed-state immutability remain preserved.
Scalar owned-receipt accessors were made pure; the EB-I21R-introduced function-elimination warnings are absent from the final green run.

warning_debt.remaining_observed_warnings: Pre-existing warnings remain in transaction reference, canonical interval runtime, solver stubs/contracts, legacy HeadCalc, bottom sensible-energy comparison, serialized reference backend, and EB-I18 verifier/test code; EB-I21R does not claim to remediate them.

invariant_assessment.notes: Owner association is runtime scratch/provenance, not persistent column state. Logical column identity stays outside the generic kernel receipt. No second water ledger or hidden global identity is introduced.
